title: Quick update: combat is now smoother, and there’s a short cutscene.
author: Background_Ranger667
selftext: Let me know what you think

comments.author: Mother_Tifa
comments.body: # This one is quite simple in terms of its fluidity

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: Appreciate the input! Is there a specific movement or transition that felt off to you? I'm working on polishing the animations right now

comments.author: takshit2
comments.body: Animation is familiar. You use mixamo?

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: I don’t know why, but I think it fits too well :D

replies.author: Haster
replies.body: lol, don't mind me, I'm just jelous cuz I use the same library but the results aren't nearly as nice

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: Haha, thanks! Appreciate the kind words. We've all been there with trial and error!

comments.author: jimbojohndoe
comments.body: Ah Kaykit assets, my friend right there. Smooth combat I would say, also nice breaking down of the skeletons when they fall down, though the blood is kind of funny.

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: Haha, good eye on the Kaykit assets! And yeah, bleeding skeletons is definitely a bit silly I might have to tweak or remove that effect for the undead enemies. Glad you liked the combat and the skeleton breakup though!

comments.author: Background_Ranger667
comments.body: I now have a complete damage system for the player, as well as a boss fight if you’d like, I can post it for you guys.

comments.author: zsxzo
comments.body: I hate cutscenes like this in games but it seems particularly bad as you can already see the next room. It is a little jarring that it cuts to a zoom in then pans out - the intro/exit should be the same IMO. I would hide the room and only display after it opens if you keep a cutscene

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: I’ve already solved that the room ahead is now visible only as something shrouded in mist.

replies.author: zsxzo
replies.body: That’s good. I would consider reducing the animation time as well - it’s about 5 seconds which is a long time for an action combat game to pause with no player input for a locked animation screen. Try cutting it down to 2.5 seconds.

comments.author: AdamsLineage
comments.body: This gives me happy wars vibes.

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: I had to Google it, but yeah, they really do look very similar. :D

comments.author: thePCdude
comments.body: I hope this one is a prototype cuz im prototyping something and opus literally used THE EXACT same models you used.

replies.author: Background_Ranger667
replies.body: Haha, yeah, it's definitely a prototype/WIP! Since the KayKit assets are so great and free to use, a lot of devs use them for prototyping. Good luck with your project!
